resources.string: Stream free, openly licensed music, podcasts and timeless motivational speeches — then fuse them into your own sessions with AI.
Guests can browse and stream. Create an account to sync your library, download, and save mixes.
We\'ll tune Home and AI Studio to your taste. You can change this anytime.
Get one gentle reminder a day when a new featured speech is ready. No marketing, ever.
All audio is free and openly licensed: Creative Commons music from Internet Archive netlabels, public-domain LibriVox readings, and podcasts streamed from their publishers\' public feeds.
Availability depends on each licence and your region. Podcasts are stream/download only and can\'t be remixed.
AI Studio sends your prompt and catalogue metadata (never your audio or personal data) to plan a mix. Rendering happens on your device.
You can export or delete your data anytime in Profile → Privacy.
I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
